Generate this same full-body friendly cream-white retriever detective in teal cap, green vest and shorts, backpack, fluffy tail. Preserve all clothing and proportions, but draw NEW distinct articulated utility animation poses. Wooden bat secured at backpack during utility actions. Warm detailed illustrated game style matching reference.
Composition is STRICT: portrait PNG 1024 wide by1536 high, exactly EIGHT equal columns and TWELVE equal rows, 96 cells, each128x128. No borders, no grid lines, no captions, no text. Entire single character in each cell, fully contained, same scale, common feet baseline at cell y=118; breathing/clothes/head move but whole character does not slide. One character per cell. Transparent alpha background, absolutely no scenery or shadows. If alpha impossible use perfectly uniform pure magenta #ff00ff everywhere outside character.
Rows1–4 utilityA, in order: FRONT (faces viewer), BACK (back of head, no face), LEFT profile (muzzle points screenLEFT), RIGHT profile (muzzle screenRIGHT). In each row columns1–4 four subtly different idle breathing and blinking poses; columns5–8 drinking green healing potion sequence: take small bottle from pouch, bring bottle to lips, tilt bottle/head to drink, lower bottle.
Rows5–8 utilityB in SAME front/back/left/right order. In each row columns1–6 six different conversational hand gestures with mouth expression: relaxed, raise free paw, palm open, gesture outward, lower paw, settle. Columns7–8 two hurt recoil poses: flinch with shoulders back, recover partly crouched. No gore.
Rows9–12 utilityC in SAME front/back/left/right order. In each row columns1–6 six progressively falling-defeat poses: wobble, bend knees, kneel, fall to side, lie on side, rest on ground. Character lying remains inside its own cell and keeps consistent body size. Columns7–8 interaction poses: reach free hand forward then grasp/press a small invisible object.
IMPORTANT: all96 poses must match requested cell ordering precisely, especially entire rows2,6,10 show BACK and rows3,7,11 face screenLEFT. Never rotate just the whole image, render genuinely changed anatomy/arm/knee poses. Keep character recognizable. No decorative base, no shadows, no extra characters.
